revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Treasure Map Mirror Twins
revealWordProblem.text: Captain Vega buries a chest at (-6, 4) on her treasure map. She wants to bury a decoy chest that is a mirror image of the real one, reflected across the y-axis, so raiders searching the wrong side will still find a clue. What are the coordinates of the decoy chest, and how far is it from the y-axis?
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Reflecting across the y-axis flips the sign of the x-coordinate and keeps the y-coordinate the same, so (-6, 4) becomes (6, 4). The original chest is |-6| = 6 units from the y-axis, and the decoy is also 6 units from the y-axis, just on the opposite side. The decoy chest is at (6, 4), exactly 6 units from the y-axis.

launch.narrative: Captain Vega discovers that her treasure map has a magic mirror trick! When she folds the map along the x-axis, some clues match up perfectly with clues on the other side. For example, a marker at (2, 4) has a matching marker at (2, -4) when reflected over the x-axis. Another pair reflects over the y-axis: (5, 3) and (-5, 3). How does reflection change the coordinates?

conceptIntro.heading: How do you reflect a point across an axis?
conceptIntro.intro: A reflection is a flip of a point over a line, like a mirror image. The axis you flip over decides which coordinate changes its sign.
conceptIntro.keyIdea: Reflect over the x-axis: the y-coordinate changes sign. Reflect over the y-axis: the x-coordinate changes sign.

iDo.title: Watch me
lines: I will reflect (3, 2) over the y-axis.
The y-axis is the vertical line, so the point flips left or right. That changes the x-coordinate.
The x changes sign: 3 becomes -3. The y stays the same: 2 stays 2.
So the reflection of (3, 2) over the y-axis is (-3, 2).

weDo.title: Let's try together
lines: Now let's reflect (4, -5) over the x-axis. Which coordinate changes over the x-axis? The y-coordinate.
What does -5 become when it changes sign? It becomes 5.
The x stays 4, so the reflection is what point? It is (4, 5).

optional.stem: Captain Vega folds the map along the x-axis. A marker at (7, 2) lands on its mirror image. What are the new coordinates?
optional.explanation: Folding along (reflecting across) the x-axis flips the sign of the y-coordinate only. (7, 2) becomes (7, -2).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Folding along (reflecting across) the x-axis flips the sign of the y-coordinate only.
Both coordinates changed sign, which describes two folds rather than one. Folding along the x-axis changes only one of them.
The coordinates traded places. A reflection keeps x first and y second and only changes a sign.
optional.stemEs: La Capitana Vega dobla el mapa a lo largo del eje x. Un marcador en (7, 2) cae sobre su imagen reflejada. ¿Cuáles son las nuevas coordenadas?
optional.explanationEs: Doblar sobre el eje x (reflejar a través de él) cambia solo el signo de la coordenada y. El punto (7, 2) se convierte en (7, -2).
hints: Folding along an axis makes that axis the mirror line, and the point lands the same distance away on the other side.
The x-axis runs left and right, so the fold moves the point up or down — decide which coordinate that affects.
The marker is 2 units above the x-axis, so its image must be 2 units below it. The first coordinate does not move at all.
hintsEs: Doblar a lo largo de un eje convierte ese eje en la línea espejo, y el punto cae a la misma distancia del otro lado.
El eje x va de izquierda a derecha, así que el doblez mueve el punto hacia arriba o hacia abajo: decide qué coordenada se ve afectada.
El marcador está 2 unidades arriba del eje x, así que su imagen debe estar 2 unidades abajo. La primera coordenada no se mueve.

optional.stem: A buried chest is marked at (-5, 3). Vega folds the map along the y-axis to find its mirror twin. Where is the twin?
optional.explanation: Reflecting across the y-axis flips the sign of the x-coordinate only. (-5, 3) becomes (5, 3).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Reflecting across the y-axis flips the sign of the x-coordinate only.
Both signs changed in this point. Reflecting across the y-axis leaves one coordinate exactly as it was.
The coordinates were swapped and a sign was changed. Reflections never reorder the pair.
optional.stemEs: Un cofre enterrado está marcado en (-5, 3). Vega dobla el mapa a lo largo del eje y para hallar su gemelo reflejado. ¿Dónde está el gemelo?
optional.explanationEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y cambia solo el signo de la coordenada x. El punto (-5, 3) se convierte en (5, 3).
hints: The y-axis is the vertical line through the middle of the grid, and folding along it swings the point across from left to right.
Decide which coordinate tells you how far left or right a point sits — that is the one the fold changes.
The chest is 5 units to the left of the y-axis, so the twin must be 5 units to the right. The height stays exactly where it was.
hintsEs: El eje y es la recta vertical que pasa por el centro de la cuadrícula, y doblar a lo largo de él pasa el punto de izquierda a derecha.
Decide qué coordenada indica cuánto a la izquierda o a la derecha está un punto: esa es la que cambia con el doblez.
El cofre está 5 unidades a la izquierda del eje y, así que el gemelo debe estar 5 unidades a la derecha. La altura se queda igual.

optional.stem: Vega reflects a palm-tree marker at (8, -6) across the x-axis. Which coordinate changes its sign?
optional.explanation: Across the x-axis the rule is (x, y) -> (x, -y), so only the y-coordinate flips sign. (8, -6) becomes (8, 6).
choiceFeedback: Reflecting across the x-axis flips the point up-down. Does an up-down flip move the point left or right at all? That decides which coordinate changes.
Flipping both is what happens after two reflections, one across each axis. A single reflection touches only one coordinate.
If nothing changed, the point would land back on itself. A reflection across an axis always moves a point to the mirror side.
optional.stemEs: Vega refleja un marcador de palmera en (8, -6) sobre el eje x. ¿Cuál coordenada cambia de signo?
optional.explanationEs: Sobre el eje x la regla es (x, y) → (x, -y), así que solo la coordenada y cambia de signo. El punto (8, -6) se convierte en (8, 6).
hints: A mirror line only changes the direction you travel to cross it — everything parallel to that line stays put.
The x-axis is horizontal, so ask whether the point moves sideways or up and down when it reflects.
The marker sits 6 units below the x-axis and its image sits 6 units above. Look at which position in the ordered pair recorded that distance.
hintsEs: Una línea espejo solo cambia la dirección en que hay que cruzarla; todo lo paralelo a esa línea se queda igual.
El eje x es horizontal, así que pregúntate si el punto se mueve de lado o hacia arriba y abajo al reflejarse.
El marcador está 6 unidades debajo del eje x y su imagen queda 6 unidades arriba. Fíjate en qué posición del par ordenado registraba esa distancia.

optional.label: Match each map marker and fold line to its mirror image.
optional.explanation: A fold over the x-axis keeps x and flips y, so (1, 7) → (1, -7) and (9, -3) → (9, 3). A fold over the y-axis keeps y and flips x, so (-8, 2) → (8, 2) and (-1, -6) → (1, -6). Checking which number stayed the same is the quickest way to confirm a match.
optional.explanationEs: Un doblez sobre el eje x conserva la x y cambia la y, así que (1, 7) → (1, -7) y (9, -3) → (9, 3). Un doblez sobre el eje y conserva la y y cambia la x, así que (-8, 2) → (8, 2) y (-1, -6) → (1, -6). Revisar qué número se quedó igual es la forma más rápida de confirmar una pareja.
optional.labelEs: Une cada marcador del mapa y su línea de doblez con su imagen reflejada.

optional.instructions: Sort each fold by which coordinate rule it follows on Vega's map.

categories.label: Over x-axis: keep x, flip y (x, -y)
categories.labelEs: Sobre el eje x: conserva x, cambia y (x, -y)

categories.label: Over y-axis: flip x, keep y (-x, y)
categories.labelEs: Sobre el eje y: cambia x, conserva y (-x, y)

optional.explanation: Sort by the axis named on the card, not by the signs of the coordinates. (4, 9), (-2, 5), and (6, -1) all fold over the x-axis, which follows (x, -y), while (3, 8), (-7, 4), and (2, -9) fold over the y-axis, which follows (-x, y).
optional.explanationEs: Clasifica por el eje que nombra la tarjeta, no por los signos de las coordenadas. (4, 9), (-2, 5) y (6, -1) se doblan sobre el eje x, que sigue (x, -y), mientras que (3, 8), (-7, 4) y (2, -9) se doblan sobre el eje y, que sigue (-x, y).
optional.instructionsEs: Clasifica cada doblez según la regla de coordenadas que sigue en el mapa de Vega.

optional.title: Level 2 Extension — Vega's Fold Mix-Up

workedExample.label: Problem
workedExample.work: Reflect the marker (6, 4) across the x-axis.
workedExample.workEs: Refleja el marcador (6, 4) sobre el eje x.

workedExample.label: Step 1
workedExample.work: The x-axis is the fold line, so flip the sign of the x-coordinate.
workedExample.workEs: El eje x es la línea de pliegue, así que cambia el signo de la coordenada x.

workedExample.label: Step 2
workedExample.work: Change 6 to -6 and keep y as 4.
workedExample.workEs: Cambia el 6 a -6 y conserva la y como 4.

optional.correctWork: Reflecting across the x-axis follows the rule (x, y) -> (x, -y): keep the x-coordinate and flip the y-coordinate. Vega flipped the x instead of the y. The correct mirror image of (6, 4) is (6, -4).
hints: The axis you fold over is the one that stays put. Folding over the x-axis means the x-value should NOT change.
Across the x-axis: keep x, flip y -> (x, -y). So (6, 4) should become (6, -4), not (-6, 4).
optional.titleEs: Extensión Nivel 2 — La confusión de dobleces de Vega
optional.explanation: Step 1 says to flip the x-coordinate for an x-axis fold, but the axis you fold over is the one whose coordinate stays put. The rule is (x, y) → (x, -y), so the marker (6, 4) mirrors to (6, -4), landing straight below the original.
optional.explanationEs: El paso 1 dice que hay que cambiar la coordenada x para un doblez sobre el eje x, pero el eje sobre el que doblas es aquel cuya coordenada se queda igual. La regla es (x, y) → (x, -y), así que el marcador (6, 4) se refleja en (6, -4) y cae justo debajo del original.
optional.correctWorkEs: Reflejar sobre el eje x sigue la regla (x, y) -> (x, -y): conserva la coordenada x y cambia el signo de la y. Vega cambió la x en lugar de la y. La imagen reflejada correcta de (6, 4) es (6, -4).

approaching.stem: What is the reflection of (4, -3) over the x-axis?
approaching.explanation: Reflecting over the x-axis changes the sign of the y-coordinate. The x stays the same (4), and the y changes from -3 to 3. The answer is (4, 3).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Reflecting over the x-axis changes the sign of the y-coordinate.
Both coordinates changed sign here, which is what two reflections would do. A single reflection over the x-axis leaves one coordinate untouched — decide which one.
The two numbers traded places. Reflecting never swaps x with y; it only changes a sign.
hints: Reflecting over the x-axis flips the point UP/DOWN — the left/right position doesn't move.
Keep the x-coordinate the same and switch the sign of the y-coordinate. Don't swap the numbers' order.
The point sits 3 units below the x-axis. Its mirror sits the same 3 units above, with the x still 4.
approaching.stemEs: ¿Cuál es la reflexión de (4, -3) sobre el eje x?
approaching.explanationEs: Reflejar sobre el eje x cambia el signo de la coordenada y. La x se mantiene igual (4) y la y pasa de -3 a 3. La respuesta es (4, 3).
hintsEs: Reflejar sobre el eje x voltea el punto ARRIBA/ABAJO: la posición izquierda/derecha no se mueve.
Conserva igual la coordenada x y cambia el signo de la coordenada y. No intercambies el orden de los números.
El punto está 3 unidades debajo del eje x. Su reflejo está esas mismas 3 unidades arriba, con la x todavía en 4.

approaching.stem: What is the reflection of (-2, 6) over the y-axis?
approaching.explanation: Reflecting over the y-axis changes the sign of the x-coordinate. x goes from -2 to 2, and y stays 6. The answer is (2, 6).
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you changed the sign of both coordinates. Instead: Reflecting over the y-axis changes the sign of the x-coordinate.
Both signs flipped in this point. A reflection over the y-axis changes only one coordinate — think about which one the vertical axis affects.
The coordinates were swapped instead of reflected. Keep x in the first position and y in the second, then change only a sign.
hints: Reflecting over the y-axis flips LEFT/RIGHT — the height stays the same.
Switch the sign of the x-coordinate and keep the y-coordinate 6 unchanged.
The point is 2 units left of the y-axis. Its mirror lands 2 units to the RIGHT, at the same height.
approaching.stemEs: ¿Cuál es la reflexión de (-2, 6) sobre el eje y?
approaching.explanationEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y cambia el signo de la coordenada x. La x pasa de -2 a 2 y la y se mantiene en 6. La respuesta es (2, 6).
hintsEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y voltea IZQUIERDA/DERECHA: la altura se queda igual.
Cambia el signo de la coordenada x y conserva la coordenada y en 6 sin cambios.
El punto está 2 unidades a la izquierda del eje y. Su reflejo cae 2 unidades a la DERECHA, a la misma altura.

approaching.stem: Which point is on the y-axis?
approaching.explanation: Points on the y-axis have x-coordinate = 0. (0, 5) is on the y-axis.
choiceFeedback: You swapped the x and y—the first number is horizontal, second is vertical.
Not quite. Points on the y-axis have x-coordinate = ___.
That point sits off to one side of the vertical axis. A point resting on the y-axis has an x-coordinate of exactly 0.
hints: Points on the y-axis have gone 0 units left or right — check the FIRST coordinate.
Scan each pair's x-coordinate (the first number). Only x = 0 keeps a point on the y-axis.
Read the first number in each pair. A point sits on the y-axis only when that number is 0.
approaching.stemEs: ¿Qué punto está sobre el eje y?
approaching.explanationEs: Los puntos sobre el eje y tienen la coordenada x = 0. El punto (0, 5) está sobre el eje y.
hintsEs: Los puntos sobre el eje y se han movido 0 unidades a la izquierda o a la derecha: revisa la PRIMERA coordenada.
Revisa la coordenada x (el primer número) de cada par. Solo x = 0 mantiene un punto sobre el eje y.
Prueba (0, 5): derecha 0, arriba 5 — nunca sales del eje vertical. Ahora revisa los primeros números de los demás.

approaching.label: Match each point and axis to its reflection.
hints: Read the axis on each card: the y-axis flips the x sign; the x-axis flips the y sign. Only ONE number changes.
For each card, copy the pair, flip the correct coordinate's sign, and find that result among the matches.
Try '(2, 5) over y-axis': flip the 2's sign and keep the 5. Find the match that shows exactly that change.
approaching.explanation: The axis named on each card tells you which coordinate flips: over the y-axis only x changes sign, so (2, 5) → (-2, 5), (-3, 1) → (3, 1), and (-6, 3) → (6, 3). Over the x-axis only y changes sign, so (4, -6) → (4, 6), (-1, -4) → (-1, 4), and (5, 2) → (5, -2).
approaching.explanationEs: El eje que nombra cada tarjeta te dice qué coordenada cambia de signo: sobre el eje y solo cambia la x, así que (2, 5) → (-2, 5), (-3, 1) → (3, 1) y (-6, 3) → (6, 3). Sobre el eje x solo cambia la y, así que (4, -6) → (4, 6), (-1, -4) → (-1, 4) y (5, 2) → (5, -2).
approaching.labelEs: Une cada punto y eje con su reflexión.
hintsEs: Lee el eje de cada tarjeta: el eje y cambia el signo de x; el eje x cambia el signo de y. Solo UN número cambia.
Para cada tarjeta, copia el par, cambia el signo de la coordenada correcta y busca ese resultado entre las parejas.
Prueba '(2, 5) sobre el eje y': cambia el signo del 2 y conserva el 5. Busca la pareja que muestre exactamente ese cambio.

approaching.label: Put the steps in order for reflecting (5, -3) over the y-axis.
items: Identify the axis of reflection: y-axis
The y-axis is vertical, so the x-coordinate changes sign
Change x from 5 to -5, keep y as -3
correctOrder: Identify the axis of reflection: y-axis
The y-axis is vertical, so the x-coordinate changes sign
Change x from 5 to -5, keep y as -3
approaching.hint: Start with the first step: where do you always begin when plotting?
hints: The steps tell a story: start with the point, identify the axis, apply the rule, then state the result.
Order it: point first, axis second, then WHICH coordinate flips, then the actual sign change, then the answer.
Place 'Start with the point (5, -3)' first. Then ask: can you apply a rule before knowing the axis?
approaching.explanation: The steps go: start with (5, -3), identify the y-axis as the axis of reflection, recall that the vertical y-axis flips the x-coordinate, change 5 to -5 while keeping y as -3, and state the reflection (-5, -3). You cannot decide which coordinate flips until you know the axis, and the answer only comes after the sign change is made.
approaching.explanationEs: Los pasos van así: empezar con (5, -3), identificar el eje y como el eje de reflexión, recordar que el eje y vertical cambia la coordenada x, cambiar 5 por -5 conservando y como -3, y decir la reflexión (-5, -3). No puedes decidir qué coordenada cambia antes de saber el eje, y la respuesta solo llega después de hacer el cambio de signo.
approaching.labelEs: Ordena los pasos para reflejar (5, -3) sobre el eje y.
hintsEs: Los pasos cuentan una historia: empieza con el punto, identifica el eje, aplica la regla y luego di el resultado.
Ordénalo: primero el punto, segundo el eje, luego CUÁL coordenada cambia, luego el cambio de signo y luego la respuesta.
Coloca 'Empieza con el punto (5, −3)' primero. Luego pregunta: ¿puedes aplicar una regla sin saber el eje?

approaching.title: Spot the Common Mistake

workedExample.label: Problem
workedExample.work: Reflect the point (6, 4) over the y-axis.
workedExample.workEs: Refleja el punto (6, 4) sobre el eje y.

workedExample.label: Attempt
workedExample.work: The y-axis is vertical, so I will change the y-coordinate: 4 becomes -4. The answer is (6, -4).
workedExample.workEs: El eje y es vertical, así que cambiaré la coordenada y: 4 se convierte en -4. La respuesta es (6, -4).

workedExample.label: Check
workedExample.work: The point only moved up and down, but a fold over the vertical y-axis should move it left and right.
workedExample.workEs: El punto solo se movió hacia arriba y abajo, pero un pliegue sobre el eje y vertical debería moverlo a la izquierda y a la derecha.

approaching.correctWork: Reflecting over the y-axis changes the x-coordinate, not the y-coordinate. The rule is (x, y) -> (-x, y). For (6, 4), flip x: 6 becomes -6, and keep y as 4. The correct reflection is (-6, 4), not (6, -4).
hints: The y-axis is the vertical line. Folding over it moves a point left or right, so the x-coordinate is what changes.
Over the y-axis: (x, y) -> (-x, y). So (6, 4) becomes (-6, 4), not (6, -4).
approaching.explanation: The Attempt step flips the y-coordinate, but folding over the vertical y-axis moves a point left or right, which is the x-coordinate's job. The rule is (x, y) → (-x, y), so (6, 4) reflects to (-6, 4), not (6, -4).
approaching.explanationEs: El paso Intento cambia la coordenada y, pero doblar sobre el eje y vertical mueve el punto a la izquierda o a la derecha, y eso le corresponde a la coordenada x. La regla es (x, y) → (-x, y), así que (6, 4) se refleja en (-6, 4), no en (6, -4).
approaching.correctWorkEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y cambia la coordenada x, no la y. La regla es (x, y) -> (-x, y). Para (6, 4), cambia la x: 6 se convierte en -6, y conserva la y como 4. La reflexión correcta es (-6, 4), no (6, -4).

onLevel.label: Plot (1, 4) and its reflections: over the x-axis, over the y-axis, and over both axes
onLevel.hint: Plot each point by moving right first, then up from the origin.
hints: Each reflection flips exactly one thing: x-axis flips the y sign; y-axis flips the x sign; both axes flip both.
Start from (1, 4) each time. Write the three mirror pairs on paper first, then plot all four points.
Plot the original: right 1, up 4. For 'over x-axis,' keep x = 1 and flip the y's sign — straight below it.
onLevel.explanation: Starting from (1, 4), reflecting over the x-axis keeps x and flips y to give (1, -4); reflecting over the y-axis keeps y and flips x to give (-1, 4); and doing both flips gives (-1, -4). The four points sit at the corners of a rectangle centered on the origin, one in each quadrant.
onLevel.explanationEs: Partiendo de (1, 4), reflejar sobre el eje x conserva la x y cambia la y para dar (1, -4); reflejar sobre el eje y conserva la y y cambia la x para dar (-1, 4); y hacer ambos cambios da (-1, -4). Los cuatro puntos quedan en las esquinas de un rectángulo centrado en el origen, uno en cada cuadrante.

onLevel.instructions: Find the reflection of each point over the given axis.
onLevel.hint: For each row, reflect the point over the given axis and write the new coordinates.
hints: The axis column tells you which coordinate flips: x-axis flips the y; y-axis flips the x. The other number stays.
Copy the original pair, change only ONE sign, and keep the coordinates in the same order. Watch the rows with a 0.
Row 1: (3, -7) over the x-axis — keep the 3, flip the sign of -7, and write the new pair in (x, y) order.
onLevel.explanation: Read the Axis column, then flip only that one coordinate: over the x-axis (3, -7) → (3, 7), (8, -1) → (8, 1), and (0, 9) → (0, -9); over the y-axis (-5, 2) → (5, 2), (-4, -6) → (4, -6), and (-3, 0) → (3, 0). A coordinate of 0 is its own opposite, which is why (0, 9) and (-3, 0) each keep their zero exactly as it was.
onLevel.explanationEs: Lee la columna Eje y luego cambia solo esa coordenada: sobre el eje x, (3, -7) → (3, 7), (8, -1) → (8, 1) y (0, 9) → (0, -9); sobre el eje y, (-5, 2) → (5, 2), (-4, -6) → (4, -6) y (-3, 0) → (3, 0). Una coordenada de 0 es su propio opuesto, por eso (0, 9) y (-3, 0) conservan su cero tal cual.
onLevel.instructionsEs: Encuentra la reflexión de cada punto sobre el eje indicado.
hintsEs: La columna del eje te dice qué coordenada cambia: el eje x cambia la y; el eje y cambia la x. El otro número se queda.
Copia el par original, cambia solo UN signo y conserva las coordenadas en el mismo orden. Cuidado con las filas que tienen un 0.
Fila 1: (3, −7) sobre el eje x — conserva el 3, cambia el signo de −7 y escribe el par nuevo en orden (x, y).

pairs.matchEs: La coordenada y cambia de signo
La coordenada x cambia de signo
Se refleja en sí mismo sobre el eje x
Se refleja en sí mismo sobre el eje y

pairs.match: Reflects to itself over any axis
pairs.matchEs: Se refleja en sí mismo sobre cualquier eje

onLevel.label: Match each reflection rule to its description.
hints: Each rule pairs an action with what changes — think about which coordinate each axis controls.
The y-axis is vertical, so crossing it changes left/right (the x). The x-axis is horizontal, so crossing it changes up/down (the y).
Start with 'Over x-axis': crossing the horizontal axis moves you up/down, so find the card about the y-coordinate.
onLevel.explanation: Crossing the horizontal x-axis moves a point up or down, so 'Over x-axis' pairs with the y-coordinate changing sign; crossing the vertical y-axis moves it left or right, so 'Over y-axis' pairs with the x-coordinate changing sign, and doing both changes both. A point already sitting on an axis has a 0 in the coordinate that would flip, so it reflects to itself — and (0, 0) is on both axes, so it never moves.
onLevel.explanationEs: Cruzar el eje x horizontal mueve un punto hacia arriba o hacia abajo, así que «Sobre el eje x» se empareja con el cambio de signo de la coordenada y; cruzar el eje y vertical lo mueve a la izquierda o a la derecha, así que «Sobre el eje y» se empareja con el cambio de signo de la coordenada x, y hacer ambas cosas cambia las dos. Un punto que ya está sobre un eje tiene un 0 en la coordenada que cambiaría, así que se refleja en sí mismo, y (0, 0) está sobre los dos ejes, así que nunca se mueve.
onLevel.labelEs: Une cada regla de reflexión con su descripción.
hintsEs: Cada regla junta una acción con lo que cambia: piensa qué coordenada controla cada eje.
El eje y es vertical, así que cruzarlo cambia izquierda/derecha (la x). El eje x es horizontal, así que cruzarlo cambia arriba/abajo (la y).
Empieza con 'Sobre el eje x': cruzar el eje horizontal te mueve arriba/abajo, así que busca la tarjeta que habla de la coordenada y.

onLevel.stem: Point A is at (-3, 5). It is reflected over the x-axis to A', then A' is reflected over the y-axis to A''. What are the coordinates of A''?
onLevel.explanation: Over x-axis: (-3, 5) → (-3, -5). Then over y-axis: (-3, -5) → (3, -5). Both coordinates changed sign.
choiceFeedback: The first coordinate at origin is not 1.
Both coordinates at origin are the same value — 0.
One coordinate is correct, but check the other.
hints: Two flips happen in a row — do them one at a time, not both at once.
The first flip (x-axis) changes only the y sign. Then flip THAT result over the y-axis, changing only the x sign.
Step 1: (-3, 5) over the x-axis — keep the -3 and flip the 5. Carry that new point into the second reflection.
onLevel.stemEs: El punto A está en (-3, 5). Se refleja sobre el eje x hasta A', y luego A' se refleja sobre el eje y hasta A''. ¿Cuáles son las coordenadas de A''?
onLevel.explanationEs: Sobre el eje x: (-3, 5) → (-3, -5). Luego sobre el eje y: (-3, -5) → (3, -5). Ambas coordenadas cambiaron de signo.
hintsEs: Ocurren dos reflexiones seguidas: hazlas una a la vez, no las dos juntas.
La primera reflexión (eje x) cambia solo el signo de y. Luego refleja ESE resultado sobre el eje y, cambiando solo el signo de x.
Paso 1: (−3, 5) sobre el eje x — conserva el −3 y cambia el 5. Lleva ese punto nuevo a la segunda reflexión.

onLevel.title: Spot the Common Mistake

workedExample.label: Problem
workedExample.work: Reflect the point (-3, -8) over the x-axis.
workedExample.workEs: Refleja el punto (-3, -8) sobre el eje x.

workedExample.label: Attempt
workedExample.work: Both coordinates are negative, so I will flip the x-coordinate: -3 becomes 3. The answer is (3, -8).
workedExample.workEs: Ambas coordenadas son negativas, así que cambiaré la coordenada x: -3 se convierte en 3. La respuesta es (3, -8).

workedExample.label: Check
workedExample.work: Folding over the horizontal x-axis should send the point up across the axis, but this answer kept it below the axis.
workedExample.workEs: Plegar sobre el eje x horizontal debería mandar el punto hacia arriba cruzando el eje, pero esta respuesta lo dejó debajo del eje.

onLevel.correctWork: Reflecting over the x-axis changes the y-coordinate, not the x-coordinate. The rule is (x, y) -> (x, -y). For (-3, -8), keep x as -3 and flip y: -8 becomes 8. The correct reflection is (-3, 8), not (3, -8). The negative signs do not change which coordinate flips — the axis does.
hints: The x-axis is the horizontal line. Folding over it moves a point up or down, so the y-coordinate is what changes sign.
Over the x-axis: (x, y) -> (x, -y). So (-3, -8) becomes (-3, 8), not (3, -8).
onLevel.explanation: The Attempt step flips the x-coordinate because both numbers are negative, but the signs of the coordinates never decide which one flips — the axis does. Over the x-axis the rule is (x, y) → (x, -y), so (-3, -8) reflects to (-3, 8), moving up across the horizontal axis.
onLevel.explanationEs: El paso Intento cambia la coordenada x porque los dos números son negativos, pero los signos de las coordenadas nunca deciden cuál cambia: lo decide el eje. Sobre el eje x la regla es (x, y) → (x, -y), así que (-3, -8) se refleja en (-3, 8) y sube cruzando el eje horizontal.
onLevel.correctWorkEs: Reflejar sobre el eje x cambia la coordenada y, no la x. La regla es (x, y) -> (x, -y). Para (-3, -8), conserva la x como -3 y cambia la y: -8 se convierte en 8. La reflexión correcta es (-3, 8), no (3, -8). Los signos negativos no deciden cuál coordenada cambia — lo decide el eje.

extending.title: Find the Reflection Error

workedExample.label: Student thinking
workedExample.work: The y-axis is vertical, so I change the y-coordinate
workedExample.workEs: El eje y es vertical, así que cambio la coordenada y

extending.correctWork: Reflecting over the y-axis changes the x-coordinate, not the y-coordinate. The correct reflection of (-3, 5) over the y-axis is (3, 5). The student confused which coordinate changes for each axis.
hints: The y-AXIS is the vertical line. Points flip ACROSS it, meaning they move left/right. Which coordinate controls left/right?
Over the y-axis: change x. Over the x-axis: change y. The name of the axis tells you which coordinate STAYS the same.
extending.explanation: The student's thinking step says the vertical y-axis changes the y-coordinate, but the axis name tells you which coordinate stays the same. Over the y-axis the rule is (x, y) → (-x, y), so (-3, 5) reflects to (3, 5), not (-3, -5).
extending.explanationEs: El paso del razonamiento del estudiante dice que el eje y vertical cambia la coordenada y, pero el nombre del eje te dice cuál coordenada se queda igual. Sobre el eje y la regla es (x, y) → (-x, y), así que (-3, 5) se refleja en (3, 5), no en (-3, -5).
extending.correctWorkEs: Reflejar sobre el eje y cambia la coordenada x, no la y. La reflexión correcta de (-3, 5) sobre el eje y es (3, 5). El estudiante confundió cuál coordenada cambia con cada eje.

extending.prompt: A triangle has vertices at A(1, 2), B(4, 2), and C(4, 6). If you reflect the entire triangle over the y-axis, what are the new vertices? What do you notice about the size and shape of the reflected triangle compared to the original?
extending.sentenceFrame: The reflected vertices are A'(___), B'(___), C'(___). I found each by ___. The reflected triangle is ___ compared to the original because reflections ___.
extending.hint: Use examples with specific coordinates to explain your thinking.
hints: Reflect each vertex separately over the y-axis: only the x-coordinates change sign.
Apply the rule to A(1, 2), B(4, 2), and C(4, 6) one at a time. Then compare the side lengths of both triangles.
Start with A(1, 2): flip the 1 to its opposite and keep the 2. Do B and C the same way, then compare shapes.
extending.explanation: Reflect each vertex over the y-axis by flipping only the x-coordinate: A(1, 2) → A'(-1, 2), B(4, 2) → B'(-4, 2), and C(4, 6) → C'(-4, 6). The reflected triangle is congruent to the original — same side lengths and same angles — because a reflection is a mirror flip that turns the figure around without stretching or shrinking it.
extending.explanationEs: Refleja cada vértice sobre el eje y cambiando solo la coordenada x: A(1, 2) → A'(-1, 2), B(4, 2) → B'(-4, 2) y C(4, 6) → C'(-4, 6). El triángulo reflejado es congruente con el original —mismos lados y mismos ángulos— porque una reflexión es un volteo en espejo que gira la figura sin estirarla ni encogerla.
extending.promptEs: Un triángulo tiene vértices en A(1, 2), B(4, 2) y C(4, 6). Si reflejas todo el triángulo sobre el eje y, ¿cuáles son los vértices nuevos? ¿Qué observas sobre el tamaño y la forma del triángulo reflejado en comparación con el original?
hintsEs: Refleja cada vértice por separado sobre el eje y: solo cambian de signo las coordenadas x.
Aplica la regla a A(1, 2), B(4, 2) y C(4, 6) una a la vez. Luego compara las longitudes de los lados de ambos triángulos.
Empieza con A(1, 2): cambia el 1 por su opuesto y conserva el 2. Haz B y C igual y luego compara las figuras.

extending.label: Plot the point (-2, 3). Reflect it over the x-axis, then reflect that result over the y-axis. Where do you end up? Now start over and reflect (-2, 3) over the y-axis first, then over the x-axis. Do you get the same final point?
extending.hint: Plot each point by moving right first, then up from the origin.
hints: You'll trace two different paths from (-2, 3) — one flips over the x-axis first, the other over the y-axis first.
Path 1: flip the y sign, then flip the x sign. Path 2: flip the x first, then the y. Track each stop as its own point.
Path 1, step 1: (-2, 3) over the x-axis keeps x = -2 and flips the 3. Plot that stop before moving on.
extending.explanation: Path 1 sends (-2, 3) over the x-axis to (-2, -3), then over the y-axis to (2, -3). Path 2 sends (-2, 3) over the y-axis to (2, 3), then over the x-axis to (2, -3) as well — the order does not matter, because either way both signs end up flipped.
extending.explanationEs: El camino 1 lleva (-2, 3) sobre el eje x a (-2, -3), y luego sobre el eje y a (2, -3). El camino 2 lleva (-2, 3) sobre el eje y a (2, 3), y luego sobre el eje x también a (2, -3): el orden no importa, porque de cualquier manera terminan cambiando los dos signos.

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake in Reflect Points Across Axes is flipping the sign of the wrong coordinate — changing the x-coordinate when reflecting over the x-axis, instead of the y-coordinate (or vice versa for the y-axis). For example, to reflect (3, -5) over the x-axis, a student might flip the x-coordinate and write (-3, -5), but reflecting over the x-axis only changes the sign of the y-coordinate: (3, -5) becomes (3, 5). Before you submit, ask: 'Did I flip the sign of the coordinate that matches the axis I'm reflecting over — y for the x-axis, x for the y-axis?'

connect.scenario: A game designer creates a spaceship at (3, 2) and wants to place enemy ships as reflections to make the level symmetric. One enemy is reflected over the y-axis, and another is reflected over the x-axis.
connect.promptQuestion: How do reflections help the game designer create a balanced, symmetric level?
connect.prompt: The enemy reflected over the y-axis is at ___ because ___. The enemy reflected over the x-axis is at ___ because ___. Reflections help game designers because ___.

check.stem: Where is the ship after reflecting (3, 2) over the y-axis?
check.explanation: The y-axis is a vertical mirror, so only the x-coordinate flips sign: (3, 2) → (−3, 2).

check.stem: Where is the ship after reflecting (3, 2) over the x-axis?
check.explanation: The x-axis is a horizontal mirror, so only the y-coordinate flips sign: (3, 2) → (3, −2).

check.stem: Reflecting over the y-axis changes which coordinate?
check.explanation: A reflection across the y-axis moves a point left-to-right across a vertical line, so its horizontal position (x) flips while its height (y) stays the same.

connect.modelAnswer: Reflecting (3, 2) over the y-axis flips the x-coordinate to give (−3, 2). Reflecting over the x-axis flips the y-coordinate to give (3, −2). Each enemy ends up the same distance from its axis as the original ship, which is what makes the level look balanced and symmetric.

exitTicket.stem: What is the reflection of (-5, 2) over the y-axis?
exitTicket.explanation: Reflecting over the y-axis changes the sign of the x-coordinate. x goes from -5 to 5, and y stays 2. The reflection is (5, 2).
choiceFeedback: Reflecting over the y-axis flips the x sign, not the y.
Only the x-coordinate changes sign over the y-axis; keep y.
Don't swap the coordinates — just flip the sign of x.
hints: The y-axis is the VERTICAL line — reflecting across it changes left/right, not up/down.
Flip only the x-coordinate's sign and keep the y as it is. Don't swap the two numbers.
The point sits 5 units LEFT of the y-axis. Its mirror sits 5 units to the right, at the same height of 2.
